correctness.rationale: Under conjugation by a Weyl operator, the Weyl inputs transform by distinct characters of the translation/modulation indices. Orthogonality over the N² projectors therefore makes the analysis columns orthogonal; their squared norms for inputs W/√N are N|⟨g,Wg⟩|², with N=q². Each normalized-window ambiguity coefficient is a graph-fiber sum divided by q, which cancels √N. The Gold derivative has kernel of size two for nonzero first-coordinate shift by gcd(k,m)=1; half of the characters of a nonempty two-point fiber agree on its difference. A purely vertical nonzero translation has no intersection. At zero translation the quadratic polar radical is given by v^(2^k)r^(2^(2k))+vr=0, by moving Frobenius through the trace. Cyclic-group divisibility gives sizes two for all nonzero v in odd dimension and four on cubes, one otherwise, in even dimension. The squared Walsh sum is q times the sum of the induced character on the radical; exactly q/|R_v| linear terms cancel the restricted quadratic form. This reconstructs the table, rank, indexed Weyl null directions and positive-spectrum condition number. Zero modulation gives the APN converse, and affine conjugation permutes shifts and dual characters up to phase, preserving the full spectrum (not generally the horizontal labels). An independent direct matrix check using 256 actual q=4 measurement projectors gave orthogonal Weyl columns and squared bands {0:198, 4:56, 16:2}. The supplied finite checks are not an all-degree proof; the orthogonality and radical argument is.
residual_risks: Counting normalization and Hilbert–Schmidt domain norm are essential. This is not nonlinear phase retrieval or a theorem for noncoprime Gold exponents.

evidence: Earlier quadratic Walsh theory gives the amplitude √(q|R|) and zeros controlled by the radical and the restriction of the phase to it. All odd-dimensional quadratic APN functions are almost bent (Remark II.5). Chase–Lisoněk gives a Gold Walsh-zero criterion for odd dimension.
Theorem II.4 covers even-dimensional quadratic APN components through their amplitude partition; it is about Walsh coefficients, not the nonzero-translation Gabor strata.
broader_coverage.reasoning: This covers the mechanism of the zero-translation band and, in odd m, its amplitude outright. The Gold specialization in even m inserts the radical dimension from a single cyclic-group equation; remaining strata use the two-point-fiber character rule.

evidence: The earlier cyclic Gabor results diagonalize using ambiguity magnitudes; the finite-abelian framework uses the corresponding group and its dual. Gram eigenvalues are squared analysis singular values.

For a binary graph, the two ordered derivative solutions in a nonempty APN fiber describe one unordered pair. APN is exactly the binary Sidon condition, not a constant-multiplicity difference-set condition.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The character-orthogonality argument carries from cyclic to elementary abelian groups without changes to the factor √|G|. The APN labels and binary Sidon language describe the same intersection property; affine invariance follows from ordinary Weyl covariance.

value.rationale: The window and operator spectrum are natural, but this exact invariant is mechanically reconstructed from established inputs: Weyl orthogonality converts each entry into a fiber-character magnitude; APN turns every nonempty off-origin horizontal fiber into two points with a half-character count; the zero-translation part is precisely the quadratic Walsh distribution. In even dimension the only extra count is the cube test obtained by taking the gcd of the exponent in the radical equation with q−1. Kernel, rank, condition number, APN converse and affine transfer are immediate readouts or covariance. No substantive gap beyond assembling these standard blocks into one table is established. This is not a claim that the table is false or that it was explicitly printed in an earlier source.
residual_risks: A genuinely different prediction not reducible to these strata, or a substantive use of the evaluated table, was not established by the frozen claim.
